# GitHub Copilot Repository Instructions

Follow [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md).

This is a portable Agent Skills repository. Keep `SKILL.md` frontmatter valid, preserve `## Output Contract` and `## Stop Conditions`, use progressive disclosure, and do not add native harness configuration. Maintainers should run `python scripts/doctor.py` and `npx skills add . --list` before proposing completion.
